name: Simple Composite
body:
Prerequisite(s): Any composite kinetic blast wild talent except force, gigawatt, or regression blast.

Benefit(s): Choose one composite blast you know.

Whenever you use it you can choose to have it deal damage as a simple blast, reducing its burn cost by 1. You cannot apply this to a composite blast which normally deals damage as a simple blast (such as force blast), negative admixture, positive admixture, or any blast which is augmenting a simple blast (such as aetheric boost).

Special: You can take this feat multiple times; each time it applies to a different composite blast.
